en.headline: M+ opens Herzog & de Meuron: In Focus for fifth anniversary
en.dek: The exhibition in the Focus Gallery presents models, drawings and material samples from the firm that designed the museum building, running from 12 September.
body: M+ has opened Herzog & de Meuron: In Focus to mark the museum’s fifth anniversary. The presentation in the Focus Gallery on Level 2 draws on a significant donation of models, drawings and material samples from the Swiss architecture firm that designed the M+ building itself.

The exhibition focuses on built and unbuilt projects in China, including M+, Tai Kwun in Hong Kong and the National Stadium in Beijing, alongside urban planning work. Objects are displayed in replicas of the wooden vitrines used in the firm’s Kabinett repository in Basel.

The show runs from 12 September 2026. Standard M+ admission applies. Opening hours are Tuesdays to Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays from 10am to 6pm, and Fridays from 10am to 10pm; the museum is closed on Mondays.

zh.headline: M+五周年展「Herzog & de Meuron：聚焦」今起開放
zh.dek: 展覽於二樓焦點空間展出設計M+大樓的瑞士事務所捐贈模型、繪圖及物料樣本，由9月12日起舉行。
body: 西九文化區M+博物館為慶祝開幕五周年，今日起在二樓焦點空間展出「Herzog & de Meuron：聚焦」。展覽展出該瑞士建築事務所向M+捐贈的模型、繪圖及物料樣本，該事務所正是設計M+大樓的團隊。
展覽聚焦該事務所在中國的建成及未建成項目，包括M+、香港大館及北京國家體育場，以及都市規劃項目。展品置於仿照事務所巴塞爾Kabinett貯藏室的木造展示櫃內。
展覽由2026年9月12日起舉行。參觀適用一般M+門票。開放時間為星期二至四、星期六及日上午10時至下午6時，星期五上午10時至晚上10時；星期一休館。
